title: The Pot on Top
lines: Tom sat at a tin pot.
A tot is at the pot.
Tip! Pop! The pot is not on top.
Mop it, Sam. Mop it, Tom.
No pop! No mop! So Tom sat.

questions.listenFor: The tot, the little one. Lines two, three and four tell the story of it. Let your child read them again if they are unsure.

questions.ask: What did Sam and Tom use to clean up?
questions.listenFor: A mop. One word is plenty. If your child is stuck, ask what Tom called for right after the pot popped.

questions.ask: Do you think the tot will go for the pot again? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is good. You are listening for a reason from the story, like nobody is holding the pot now, or tots always try again.
